falsification_criteria: Cosine similarity remains below 0.10 after training with expanded hidden layers
Latent MSE does not decrease by at least 15% relative to the baseline checkpoint
Validation loss plateaus without improvement despite increased parameter count
hypotheses.mechanism: Expanding the hidden layer widths increases the representational capacity of the predictor, enabling more accurate manifold learning and trajectory forecasting. This reduces projection error (lowering latent MSE) and improves directional alignment (increasing cosine similarity).
hypotheses.statement: The dominant failure is insufficient_model_capacity; the predictor network's hidden dimensions are too narrow to capture the underlying state-space geometry, causing low cosine similarity and suboptimal latent MSE despite adequate horizon coverage.
hypotheses.title: Insufficient Model Capacity Limits Latent Alignment
